title: Flow Detail Micro Lod No Icons
description: Remove icon display for detail and micro LOD in flow DAG rendering. Icons should only show at overview LOD.
summary: Computation/function nodes (DagNodeKind::Computation) were still eligible for center-column LOD icons whenever shows_computation_layout is active (normal/detail/micro). Added DagHost::should_paint_node_lod_icon to skip icon paint for computation nodes at those tiers while keeping overview icon-only behavior. node_icon_visible remains overview-only. Extended dag_draw_lod_node_content_matrix with computation-specific assertions. Forced flow_core WASM rebuild (pkg was stale-skipped).
